lessons.title: Question: Default
lessons.interactiveContent:
When we use the default flex-basis value of auto, how wide is each of the flex items?

As wide as its content100%50%

As wide as its content.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Two flex items use flex-basis: auto. One says News, and the other has a longer label. What sets each initial width?

Each item's own contentEach item gets 100% of the containerEach item gets exactly 50% of the container

Make sure to pick Each item's own content.

lessons.title: Question: Flex basis
lessons.interactiveContent:
How can we set the flex item size across the main axis?

Using the flex-basis propertyUsing the flex-direction propertyUsing the row value

Using the flex-basis property.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A row flex container needs one item to start at 180px along the main axis. Which declaration sets that initial size?

flex-basis: 180px;flex-direction: 180px;row: 180px;

Make sure to pick flex-basis: 180px;.

lessons.title: Example: Percentages
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set flex-basis to 25% for both flex items.

Make sure to pick 25%, followed by 25%.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Give both home and about a flex-basis of 25%.

Make sure to pick 25%, followed by 25%.

lessons.title: Example: Y basis
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the code work by matching the right values with the correct properties.

Make sure to pick 50%, followed by 50%, and finally flex.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Give both navigation items an initial basis of 50%. Enable flex layout and arrange the row in reverse HTML order.

Make sure to pick 50%, followed by 50%, flex, and finally row-reverse.

lessons.title: Example: Ideal value
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the flex item's flex-basis value wider than its flex container to show that the flex item will shrink to the ideal value.

Make sure to pick 200px, followed by 150px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Make the container 150px wide while the first item's flex-basis remains 200px.

Make sure to pick 200px, followed by 150px.

lessons.title: Question: Normal
lessons.interactiveContent:
How do we control the growing of a flex item across the main axis?

With the flex-grow propertyWith the flex-shrink propertyWith the flex-basis property

With the flex-grow property.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A flex row has unused horizontal space. Keep the first item’s basis unchanged. Which property lets it grow into that space?

flex-growflex-shrinkflex-basis

Make sure to pick flex-grow.

lessons.title: Question: Default value
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the flex-grow property with a value that will make it only as wide as its content.

0auto100

Make sure to pick 0.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A flex item should stay as wide as its content instead of claiming extra container space. Which grow declaration matches that goal?

flex-grow: 0;flex-grow: auto;flex-grow: 1;

Make sure to pick flex-grow: 0;.

lessons.title: Question: Different ratios
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which flex items have the same flex-grow value?

Items 2 and 3Items 1, 2, and 3They are all equal

Items 2 and 3.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Item 1 has flex-grow: 2, while items 2 and 3 each use 10. Which items receive equal shares of new space?

Items 2 and 3Items 1 and 2Items 1, 2, and 3

Make sure to pick Items 2 and 3.

lessons.title: Example: More space
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the first flex item take up the most space in the flex container.

Make sure to pick 3, followed by 1, and finally 1.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Give the first item three times the growth of each other item. Give the second and third equal positive growth values.

Make sure to pick flex-grow, followed by 3, flex-grow, 1, flex-grow, and finally 1.

lessons.title: Example: Default
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the default flex-grow value.

Make sure to type 0.

lessons.title: Question: Flex basis
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when a flex item cannot reach its initial flex-basis size?

It shrinksIt growsIt stops being a flex item

It shrinks.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Three flex items each start with flex-basis: 150px, but their container is only 300px wide. What happens when shrinking is allowed?

The items shrink below their initial basis sizesThe items grow until each reaches 300pxThe items stop participating in the flex layout

The items shrink below their initial basis sizes.

lessons.title: Question: Flex shrink default
lessons.interactiveContent:
Pick the default flex-shrink value.

flex-shrink: 1flex-shrink: 0flex-shrink: 500cm

flex-shrink: 1.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Flex items are wider than their container, and no flex-shrink declaration is present. Which value does the browser use by default?

flex-shrink: 1;flex-shrink: 0;flex-shrink: auto;

Make sure to pick flex-shrink: 1;.

lessons.title: Example: Overflow
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make both flex items overflow the flex container and not shrink.

Make sure to pick 0, followed by 0.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Prevent both items from shrinking, so their 150px bases overflow this container.

Make sure to pick flex-shrink, followed by 0, flex-shrink, and finally 0.

lessons.title: Example: Bigger
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the first flex item shrink more than the second.

Make sure to pick 3, followed by 1.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Make the first item shrink three times as much as the second by using 3 and 1.

Make sure to pick 3, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Example: Different numbers
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the first and the second flex items shrink less than the third.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 1.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Set the first two items to shrink equally with 1; the third keeps its stronger shrink value of 3.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Question: Default
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are the default size values for each flex item?

flex-grow: 0;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: auto;flex-grow: 1;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: 1;flex-grow: 0;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: 100%;

flex-grow: 0;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: auto;.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You remove an item’s flex: 2 0 100px; declaration. Which set of default values takes over?

flex-grow: 0;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: auto;flex-grow: 1;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: auto;flex-grow: 0;, flex-shrink: 0;, flex-basis: 100%;

flex-grow: 0;, flex-shrink: 1;, flex-basis: auto;.

lessons.title: Question: Shorthand
lessons.interactiveContent:
What is the order of properties in the flex shorthand?

flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basisflex-shrink, flex-grow, flex-basisflex-grow, flex-shrink

flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis.
lessons.hardModeContent:
An item uses flex: 2 1 120px;. What do the three values represent in order?

grow 2, shrink 1, basis 120pxshrink 2, grow 1, basis 120pxgrow 2, basis 1, shrink 120px

grow 2, shrink 1, basis 120px.

lessons.title: Example: Values
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the first item grow three times as much as the second item.

Make sure to pick 3, followed by 1.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Make the first item grow three times as fast as the second by using grow values 3 and 1.

Make sure to pick 3, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Example: Different Values
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the second flex item grow 2 times as much as the first item.

Make sure to pick 2, followed by 4.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Set the first item's grow value to 2 and the second item's grow value to 4.

Make sure to pick 2, followed by 4.

lessons.title: Example: Different Values 2
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the first and second flex item both grow and shrink.

Make sure to pick 1 followed by 1 and then 1, 1.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Make both items grow equally and shrink with their default factors, keeping their 100px bases.

Make sure to pick flex, followed by 1, 1, flex, 1, and finally 1.
